name: linkedin-mcp
description: Unofficial Claude Code plugin wrapper for the LinkedIn MCP server (mcp-server-linkedin 4.23.3 by Daniel Sticker, Apache-2.0, https://github.com/stickerdaniel/linkedin-mcp-server). Declares the server via uvx with a pinned, tested version; no server code is bundled. Not affiliated with the server's author or with LinkedIn.
